topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the core principles of innate immune recognition by defining how molecular patterns allow the host to distinguish infectious and damaged entities from self.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptor Families and Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the major families of pattern recognition receptors and the intracellular signaling pathways that trigger downstream inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Cellular Responses and Systemic Consequences of Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tissues coordinate immune cell trafficking during an inflammatory response and the systemic dangers of runaway activation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Long-Term Tissue Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the physiological processes that restore tissue homeostasis after an inflammatory challenge or adapt to persistent tissue injury.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic of the complement system.
